Instead of highlighting everything from '#[[' to ']]' as a multi-line comment, it treats only the first line as a single-line comment, leaving the rest unhighlighted. The attached image confirms this: only the '#[[' line is rendered as a comment, while the following lines are rendered as normal text, instead of all lines being grayed out as a multi-line comment.
